title: Web Components Quick Guide
description: Find a short explanation and a worked example for each idea in the Web Components course.

entries.name: Make your own HTML tag
entries.summary: A custom element is an HTML tag you define.

example.code:
<hello-reader></hello-reader>
<script>
  class HelloReader extends HTMLElement {
    connectedCallback() { this.textContent = "Hello, reader!"; }
  }
  customElements.define("hello-reader", HelloReader);
</script>

entries.name: Know when an element connects
entries.summary: connectedCallback runs when a custom element joins a document.

example.code:
<visit-note></visit-note>
<script>
  class VisitNote extends HTMLElement {
    connectedCallback() { this.textContent = "I am on the page."; }
  }
  customElements.define("visit-note", VisitNote);
</script>

entries.name: Read an attribute
entries.summary: An attribute is an extra fact written in a tag.

example.code:
<reader-name name="Mia"></reader-name>
<script>
  class ReaderName extends HTMLElement {
    connectedCallback() { this.textContent = "Hi, " + (this.getAttribute("name") || "reader"); }
  }
  customElements.define("reader-name", ReaderName);
</script>

entries.name: Watch an attribute change
entries.summary: observedAttributes names the attributes a custom element watches.

example.code:
<score-note score="2"></score-note>
<script>
  class ScoreNote extends HTMLElement {
    static observedAttributes = ["score"];
    attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) { this.textContent = "Score: " + newValue; }
  }
  customElements.define("score-note", ScoreNote);
  document.querySelector("score-note").setAttribute("score", "5");
</script>

entries.name: Create a shadow tree
entries.summary: A shadow root is a separate group of page parts inside an element.

example.code:
<shadow-note></shadow-note>
<script>
  class ShadowNote extends HTMLElement {
    constructor() {
      super();
      const root = this.attachShadow({ mode: "open" });
      const paragraph = document.createElement("p");
      paragraph.textContent = "Inside the component";
      root.append(paragraph);
    }
  }
  customElements.define("shadow-note", ShadowNote);
</script>

entries.name: Keep component styles together
entries.summary: Styles inside a shadow root usually apply to its internal elements.

example.code: Outside note

entries.name: Leave a slot for content
entries.summary: A slot is a place where the user of a component can supply content.

example.code: A story about the moon

entries.name: Give slots names
entries.summary: Named slots let a component accept different pieces of content in different places.

example.code:
Moon Trip

A space story.

entries.name: Share a JavaScript property
entries.summary: A property can accept a JavaScript value on an element.

example.code:
<point-display></point-display>
<script>
  class PointDisplay extends HTMLElement {
    set points(value) { this.textContent = "Points: " + Number(value); }
  }
  customElements.define("point-display", PointDisplay);
  document.querySelector("point-display").points = 7;
</script>

entries.name: Send a custom event
entries.summary: A custom event lets a component tell its surroundings that something happened.

entries.name: Clean up a repeating job
entries.summary: disconnectedCallback runs when a custom element leaves the document.

example.code:
<tick-note></tick-note>
<script>
  class TickNote extends HTMLElement {
    connectedCallback() { this.count = 0; this.timer = setInterval(() => { this.textContent = String(++this.count); }, 1000); }
    disconnectedCallback() { clearInterval(this.timer); }
  }
  customElements.define("tick-note", TickNote);
</script>

entries.name: Style the host with a theme value
entries.summary: The :host selector styles the custom element itself.

example.code:
<style>themed-note { --note-colour: navy; }</style><themed-note></themed-note>
<script>
  class ThemedNote extends HTMLElement {
    constructor() { super(); this.attachShadow({mode:"open"}).innerHTML = "<style>:host { display:block; color:var(--note-colour, green); padding:1rem; }</style>Read a story today."; }
  }
  customElements.define("themed-note", ThemedNote);
</script>
